_help: Pickable items. model = builder in js/features/pickup/models.js. stack = max per bag slot. price = future shop value (G). spawn.where: grass (open land, off the paths) | shore (next to a lake) | land (anywhere dry). spawn.count = how many lie in the world at once, spawn.respawn = seconds before a picked one grows back somewhere else.

items.name: Apel
items.desc: Apel merah yang renyah, jatuh dari pohon di taman.

items.name: Jamur

items.name: Ranting
